rationale: The shared header uses a smaller vertical padding when the wide Properties panel opens, lifting common controls by 2 CSS pixels. Retain the common header padding in every mode without changing the reserved width or responsive layout.

summary.ru: Устранено смещение основных кнопок шапки при переходах между Просмотром и редакторами.
summary.en: Keep shared header controls vertically stable when switching between View and editors.
